title: Strongly regular graphs: the automorphism group of a Conway 99-graph, new graphs with parameters (243,22,1,2), and a 2-adic feasibility condition
description:
Research manuscripts on strongly regular graphs, with LaTeX sources, PDFs, graph data and verification programs. Status: awaiting independent review.

  • A Conway 99-graph, if it exists, is asymmetric: statement and dependencies, a note assembling the exclusion of automorphisms of every prime order.
  • A strongly regular graph with parameters (99,14,1,2) has no automorphism of order two (computer-assisted).
  • Le graphe de Conway srg(99,14,1,2) n'a pas d'automorphisme d'ordre 3 (by hand; formalised in Lean 4).
  • A computer-free proof that a Conway 99-graph has no automorphism of order seven (formalised in Lean 4).
  • A second strongly regular graph with parameters (243,22,1,2), and two further graphs with these parameters (automorphism groups of order 864 and 3,888), with a standalone verifier.
  • A 2-adic nonexistence condition for strongly regular graphs.
  • On the 7-rank of a putative strongly regular graph with parameters (99,14,1,2).

The work was carried out with the assistance of AI systems, as declared in each manuscript; the author directed it and takes full responsibility for its content. Programs, certificates and Lean formalisations not included here are available from the author on request.
notes: Copies of A. E. Brouwer's parameter tables in data/brouwer/ are third-party reference data included only for reproducibility; they are not covered by this record's license.
